name: Mukai Kyouka
source:
A rich woman who is a member of the night zoo. 

She has a matured and beautiful appearance, but has no interest in men and only gets aroused when she sees women gets dirtied in gruesome ways. 

She used to buy female zoo caretakers who performs at the bestiality show from the director, and keeps them as bestiality slaves in her mansion.
